import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not line:
        return
    parts = line.split()
    h = int(parts[0])
    m = int(parts[1])
    
    # Handle 12-hour format (0 or 12 becomes 0)
    h = h % 12
    
    # Calculate angles
    minute_angle = 6 * m  # minute hand moves 6 degrees per minute
    hour_angle = 30 * h + 0.5 * m  # hour hand moves 30 deg per hour + 0.5 deg per minute
    
    # Find the difference
    angle = abs(minute_angle - hour_angle)
    
    # Return the smaller angle
    if angle > 180:
        angle = 360 - angle
    
    print(int(angle))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
